text: 【证券日报：外部扰动不改A股中长期运行趋势】北京时间10月14日晚间，美国公布9月CPI（消费者物价指数）数据，市场对美联储10月加息的预期显著升温。有观点认为，如果通胀持续高于目标水平，美联储可能需要维持高利率更长时间，甚至进一步加息。拉长周期来看，美联储加息预期升温，对A股市场影响有限。当前，我国货币政策独立性强，流动性保持充裕；上市公司基本面持续修复，经营活力稳步回升。外部冲击更多体现为短期情绪扰动，不会导致A股趋势性调整。
text_en: [Securities Daily: External disturbances will not change A-shares' medium- and long-term trend] On the evening of October 14 Beijing time, the U.S. released September CPI (consumer price index) data, and market expectations for a Fed rate hike in October rose markedly. Some views hold that if inflation remains above target, the Fed may need to keep rates high for longer or even raise them further. Over a longer horizon, rising Fed rate-hike expectations have limited impact on the A-share market. At present, China's monetary policy is highly independent and liquidity remains ample; listed companies' fundamentals continue to recover and business vitality is steadily picking up. External shocks are mostly reflected as short-term sentiment disturbances and will not lead to a trend reversal in A-shares.
